task.title: Setting tag expirations by using the API
task.shortdesc: To set when an image tag expires in Red Hat Quay, you can use the API.

ul.li: You have Created an OAuth access token.

step.cmd: You can set when an image a tag expires by using the PUT /api/v1/repository/{repository}/tag/{tag} command and passing in the expiration field:

info.codeblock: $ curl -X PUT \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <bearer_token>" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ --data '{ "expiration": "<seconds since epoch>" }' \ https://<quay-server.example.com>/api/v1/repository/<namespace>/<repository_name>/tag/<tag>
